items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: and then Lerone Bennett, who was the editor of Ebony magazine and a political writer

ctx.x: Greatly. I mean Albert Murray is one of my intellectual heroes, and I consider him a mentor because I knew Mr. Murray. In the early 90s I wrote him a letter because I had a book project that I wanted to do at the time and I took a look at his work, the work of John Henrik Clarke who was a black American historian on the Black Nationalists line, and then Lerone Bennett, who was the editor of Ebony magazine and a political writer.
